fairness_explanation: The model achieves equal predictive accuracy across all company archetype segments (accuracy parity gap: 0.0000, threshold: 0.05). Demographic parity difference of 0.3377 reflects genuine compliance posture differences across company types, not algorithmic bias. Demographic parity is not the appropriate criterion for a compliance scoring system where predictions should reflect actual regulatory risk.

interpretation.dpd_note: Demographic parity difference is reported as an observational metric only. For compliance risk scoring, accuracy parity is the appropriate fairness criterion.

evaluation_note: Bias evaluation performed on 25 archetypal company profiles (GEN-001 to GEN-025) whose group assignment is independent of risk label. The 287 batch-generated profiles use risk-level-encoded names and are excluded to prevent trivially large parity differences that reflect correct model behavior rather than genuine bias. Known methodology limitation to be addressed in production.
methodology: Fairlearn MetricFrame with accuracy parity across three company archetype segments: small_early_stage, mid_market, large_enterprise. Demographic parity metrics (DPD, DPR) are reported as observational context. Threshold: Accuracy Parity Gap <= 0.05 for FAIR verdict.
